title: Network Clusters
commonMistakes: Counting direct links instead of connected groups
Marking only the neighbor as visited instead of the whole explored group
Treating the diagonal as a separate cluster or ignoring it inconsistently
followUps: How would you answer the question with a union-find structure?
What changes if the network is given as an edge list instead of a matrix?
How would you maintain the cluster count as links are added over time?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
